title: How should upstream and project-local ownership origins be represented?
question: How should upstream and project-local ownership origins be represented?
answer: FND-Q24: Two ownership origins (upstream Workbench, project-local) and three classifications (portable invariants and defaults, project bindings, optional extensions). A deliberate change to a baseline assignment is divergence and needs an explicit disposition. Define relationships, including primary ownership and supporting roles, rather than the full cross-product. "An added row is a mechanical comparison fact"; "a core artifact type does not by itself prove compatibility." Renamed the Ownership origin model on 2026-09-22.
